UserSync.title: UserSync
UserSync.description: Synchronized history and bookmarks for a user, identified by their authenticated UID or a hashed offline sync key

userId.description: Firebase UID or hash of the sync key

history.description: Complete list of history and bookmarked items

updatedAt.description: When the collection was last updated

/syncData/{userId}.description: Synchronization endpoint storing the combined history and bookmarked items for each user
